text:
All forms of life benefit along with preservation of open space.
The role each animal plays in ecosystems is just beginning to be understood. The impact of losing a species to an ecosystem is not fully understood, but once gone it is irretrievable. Some endangered species may have future economic values not known today.
To quantify the negative and positive impacts of the alternatives to the proposed legislation would be a major undertaking, particularly when so little is understood about the role each species plays now or might play in the future.
